name: Evendo
description: A formerly ice-bound world being terraformed into a Eumidian paradise, once lush with life and now thawing.

timeline.summary: Kav colonists turn to Evendo for mining after wrecking Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Kav colonizers, having all but destroyed their homeworld of Kavaron, have turned their attention toward Evendo as a place to mine for natural resources.

timeline.summary: Szarel commits to the Evendo terrasymbiosis knowing he will not see it finished.
timeline.quote: Szarel is fully aware that he will not live to see the project's completion, but he has committed his life to advancing the cause.

relations.note: the Kavaronic Empire plans to invade Evendo once terraformed
relations.quote: who are already designing invasion plans to take the world for their own once the Eumidians have finished remaking it
Evendo has since undergone decades of Eumidian-directed terraformation.

pages_say.description: A frozen world with Eumidian terrasymbiosis.
An icebound world being terraformed by Eumidians, co-orbiting Sothera opposite Kavaron and coveted by the Kavaronic Empire.
A formerly ice-bound world being terraformed into a Eumidian paradise, once lush with life and now thawing.
A jungle world emerging from an ice age with a Eumidian colony.
A planet being terraformed by Eumidians that the Kav want to mine.
